schema.title: HUD layout
schema.description: Layout of the SDK HUD icons (client-sdk mod-hud / ui-kit hud-ui): side, order, visibility per segment, badge, label and icon override per item.

unlisted.description: What to do with HUD items that have no entry in `items`.

items.description: Per-item overrides by HUD item id (a module or game registered id), at most 64.

text.description: Text: values per locale, or a key of scope `localization`.

values.description: Map of locale codes to text, 1–64 locales.

slot.description: Side of the screen the icon is placed on.

order.description: Position inside the slot, ascending; ties are resolved by id.

filters.description: Show the icon only to players matching this filter (segments, platform; sdk.filters FilterExpr).

badge.description: Static badge shown on the icon.

icon.description: AssetRef: skin key, app upload key or catalog ID, or HTTPS URL on the configured CDN host.
